description: Geinduceerde aardbevingen is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by kaartportaal.drenthe.nl. Map indicates the location where induced quakes have occurred. Induced tremors are caused by human actions, often as a result of gas extraction. This file was obtained from the KNMI and reflects the findings from 2005 to 2010. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Induced earthquakes" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2011-11-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
